title: 第015章 连环暴击返还这才是真正的底蕴第016章 桃木剑杀人黄符纸抽魂披着道袍的恶鬼
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
伴随着一连串密集的提示音，五团耀眼的光芒如同流星般从天而降，悬浮在苏辰面前。
最先映入眼帘的，是一团翻滚着浓郁黑芒的光球。
光芒散去，一柄散发着森寒气息的骨剑静静悬浮。
剑长三尺出头，通体乌黑如墨，剑脊极其厚实，给人一种不可撼动的力量感！
而那剑锋，却薄得几乎透明，透着令人胆寒的锋锐。
整柄剑像是用某种兽骨精心打磨而成，表面流转着沉沉的暗黑光泽！
剑格处雕刻着一圈细密繁复的骨纹，形如恶犬交错的獠牙，择人而噬。
只要靠近几分，便能感受到一股极其纯粹的淡淡血煞之味。
这股煞气并不杂乱邪恶，反而里面还带着一股黑狗血独有的、浩然刚烈的辟邪气息！
“好剑！”
苏辰眼中爆射出狂喜的光芒，一把伸手握住了剑柄。
入手冰凉彻骨，重量比他之前用的桃木剑沉了足足一倍有余。
他深吸一口气，调动体内一缕精纯的灵力，猛地灌入剑身。
嗡——！
黑煞骨剑发出一声高亢的剑鸣，剑身剧烈一颤，剑锋之上瞬间浮现出一线暗红色的冷厉光芒。
那光芒不亮，却宛如实质，贴着吹毛断发的剑刃缓缓游走，散发着危险气息。
苏辰手腕猛地一转，骨剑在掌中划开一完美的半圆。
嗤——！
剑锋撕裂空气，竟发出一声低沉而凄厉的尖啸，仿佛有凶魂在剑下哀鸣！
他脑海中，这几日苦修领悟至大成的【斩邪剑法】，如行云流水般一式式流淌而过。

起手。
斜斩！
封喉！！
过去使用桃木剑时，苏辰总觉得有些杀招施展出来，差了那么一口淋漓尽致的杀伐狠劲。
桃木剑胜在阳气充足和承载道法，可若是对上五鬼道邪修那种凝练的护身鬼气，桃木剑极易被污秽的鬼气缠绕污染。
但这柄【黑煞骨剑】截然不同！
它有凶煞之气，有锋芒，更有着克制天下万邪的破邪属性！
这简直就是为了承接【斩邪剑法】里那股“剑出斩邪，意在荡魔”的狠戾剑意而量身打造的绝世神兵！
苏辰眼底精光爆闪，忍不住赞叹出声：“今晚的主攻，就全靠你了！”
他眼神一凛，手腕猛地发力，隔空朝着数米外的一片草地随意斩出一剑。
唰！
剑锋落下，脚边一片草叶被隔空割断。
断口处平滑如镜，甚至还残留着一丝正在不断侵蚀生机的黑红煞气！
“好强……”
苏辰心潮澎湃，反手将骨剑收回系统自带的剑鞘之中。
这件凡阶极品法器，来得正是时候！
他按捺住激动的心情，看向第二团光芒。
那是三张通体泛着黑红光泽的黄符！
符纸的边缘仿佛被鲜血浸透，符面上的朱砂纹路走势刚硬霸道，每一笔都像是一柄柄出鞘的小剑，死死压在纸面上。
苏辰指腹轻轻擦过符面，瞬间便能感觉到里面蕴藏着的那股专破天下阴煞的狂暴力量。
content_en:
Accompanied by a series of dense prompts, five dazzling lights fell from the sky like meteors, floating in front of Su Chen.
The first thing that caught the eye was a rolling ball of light with a rich black glow.
The light dissipated, and a bone sword exuding a cold aura floated quietly.
The sword is over three feet long, and its entire body is as black as ink. The spine of the sword is extremely thick, giving people an unshakable sense of power!
But the edge of the sword was so thin that it was almost transparent, revealing a terrifying sharpness.
The entire sword seemed to be carefully polished from some kind of animal bone, with a deep dark luster flowing on its surface!
The sword grid is engraved with a circle of fine and complex bone patterns, shaped like the interlaced fangs of a vicious dog that chooses to devour people.
As long as you get closer, you can feel an extremely pure and faint smell of blood.
This evil spirit is not messy and evil, but it also contains a strong evil-fighting aura that is unique to Black Dog Blood!
"What a sword!"
Su Chen's eyes burst into ecstasy, and he reached out and grasped the hilt of the sword.
It was cold to the bone and weighed more than twice as much as the peach wood sword he used before.
He took a deep breath, mobilized a ray of pure spiritual power in his body, and poured it into the sword body.
Buzz—!
The Black Evil Bone Sword let out a high-pitched sword cry, the sword body trembled violently, and a dark red cold light suddenly appeared on the sword's edge.
The light was not bright, but it was like substance, moving slowly against the broken hair of the sword, exuding a dangerous aura.
Su Chen turned his wrist suddenly, and the bone sword opened a perfect semicircle in his palm.
laugh--!
The blade of the sword tore through the air and let out a low and shrill scream, as if there was a vicious spirit wailing under the sword!
In his mind, the [Evil-Slaying Sword Technique] that he had mastered through hard training in the past few days flowed past like clouds and flowing water.
Start.
Cut diagonally!
Seal your throat! !
When Su Chen used the Taomu Sword in the past, he always felt that some of his killing moves lacked the full and vivid killing power.
The peach wood sword is superior because of its abundant yang energy and the ability to carry Taoism. However, if it is faced with the condensed protective ghost energy of the Five Ghost Dao evil cultivators, the peach wood sword can easily be entangled and contaminated by the dirty ghost energy.
But this [Black Evil Bone Sword] is totally different!
It has a fierce aura, a sharp edge, and has the evil-destroying property to restrain all evils in the world!
This is simply a peerless magic weapon tailor-made to inherit the ruthless sword intent of "The sword is out to slay evil, with the intention of destroying demons" in [Evil-Slaying Sword Technique]!
Su Chen's eyes sparkled, and he couldn't help but praise: "Tonight's main attack depends entirely on you!"
With a sharp look in his eyes, he exerted force on his wrist, and slashed out a sword at random toward a piece of grass a few meters away.
Uh-huh!
The sword edge fell, and a blade of grass at his feet was cut through the air.
The fracture is as smooth as a mirror, and there is even a trace of the black and red evil spirit that is constantly eroding the vitality!
"So strong..."
Su Chen's heart surged, and he put the bone sword back into the scabbard that came with the system.
This top-grade mortal magic weapon came at just the right time!
He suppressed his excitement and looked at the second ball of light.
Those are three yellow talismans with a black and red luster all over their bodies!
The edge of the talisman paper seemed to be soaked with blood, and the cinnabar lines on the talisman surface were firm and domineering. Each stroke was like a small unsheathed sword pressed firmly against the paper.
Su Chen's fingertips lightly brushed against the face of the talisman, and he could instantly feel the violent power contained in it that was designed to break through the world's evil spirits.
